preconditions.description: The number of affected settlements m and total settlements n satisfy 1 <= m <= n <= 100000.
The damage range d is between 0 and n-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p_list) == m and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p_list) and len(set(p_list)) == m
preconditions.description: The list of affected settlements contains exactly m distinct integers between 1 and n.
There are exactly n-1 edges provided, forming a tree structure connecting all n settlements.

postconditions.expression: output_str == str(sum(1 for v in range(1, n + 1) if all(dist(v, p) <= d for p in p_list)))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of settlements v such that the distance from v to every affected settlement p is at most d.
